text: げんきな　ポケモンは　にげやすいし　うんも　あるからな！

structure.jp: げんきな　ポケモンは
うんも　あるからな！
structure.en: because luck is part of it too, you know!

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい stuck onto a verb means it happens easily. にげやすい = 'get away easily'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a phrase lists one reason and hints more are coming: 'and what's more'. にげやすいし = 'they get away easily, and besides'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から at the end gives the reason for what was said just before. うんも あるからな = 'because luck plays a part too, you know'.
